# Zhedong Zheng (郑哲东)

> Tenure-track Assistant Professor at University of Macau, hosting the AIGC-DL Lab. Computer Vision researcher specializing in AIGC, Spatial Intelligence, Data-centric AI, Object Re-identification, and Domain Adaptation. 90+ papers (including preprints), H-index 41, 14k+ citations. IEEE Senior Member. Actively recruiting PhD students and postdocs; research is steadily published at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, ACM MM, SIGIR, and ICRA.

Zhedong Zheng earned his Ph.D. from the ReLER Lab at University of Technology Sydney (supervised by Prof. Yi Yang and Dr. Liang Zheng), his B.S. from Fudan University (2016), and was a postdoctoral fellow at NUS with Prof. Tat-Seng Chua and Prof. Angela Yao. His research focuses on building reliable AI through better data, uncertainty estimation, and multi-view spatial intelligence.

## Research
- [Research Interests](https://zdzheng.xyz/): AIGC, Data-centric AI, Spatial Intelligence, Object Re-identification, Domain Adaptation, Geo-localization, Person Re-identification, Vehicle Re-ID, 3D Vision, Generative AI, Uncertainty Estimation
- [Publications](https://zdzheng.xyz/publications/): 90+ papers at top-tier venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, ACM MM, ACL, etc.) with PDFs, code, datasets, and BibTeX

## Recent Highlights (2026)
- [ACM MM 2026](https://zdzheng.xyz/publication/): two papers on dynamic aerial matching and audio-visual semantic segmentation
- [ACL 2026](https://zdzheng.xyz/publication/): two papers on multimodal forgery reasoning and facial forgery attribution
- [EMNLP 2026 Findings](https://zdzheng.xyz/publication/): three papers on uncertainty in multimodal models, medical RAG, and causal intervention
- [CVPR 2026](https://zdzheng.xyz/publication/): manipulation detection against MLLM-crafted narratives
- [ICLR 2026](https://zdzheng.xyz/publication/): efficient sketch-style reasoning in large multimodal models
- [npj AI 2026](https://zdzheng.xyz/publication/): 3D Magic Mirror, clothing reconstruction from a single image
- Journal works in TIP, TMM, PR, TVCG, TOMM, TNNLS on geo-localization, person search, and generative models

## Key Datasets
- [University-1652](https://github.com/layumi/University1652-Baseline): Multi-view multi-source benchmark for drone-based geo-localization (ACM MM 2020)
- [GeoText-1652](https://multimodalgeo.github.io/GeoText/): Natural language-guided drone geo-localization benchmark (ECCV 2024)
- [UniV](https://zdzheng.xyz/publication/Video2BE2025): Video-based geo-localization dataset extending University-1652 (ICCV 2025)
